title: Space Debris Convoy
description: N pieces of space debris are traveling along a narrow orbital lane towards a monitoring station located at position target. Each piece starts at a given position and travels at a constant speed. When a faster piece catches up to a slower piece, they merge and travel together at the speed of the slower piece. A convoy is formed by one or more pieces arriving at the destination at the exact same time. Calculate how many convoys will reach the monitoring station.
input_format: Integer target, arrays position and speed.
output_format: An integer representing the number of separate convoys that reach the destination.

examples.explanation: The pieces starting at 10 and 8 form a convoy. The pieces at 5 and 3 form another. The piece at 0 forms its own. Total 3 convoys.
Only one piece of debris, so exactly 1 convoy.
All pieces eventually merge into a single convoy before reaching target 100.
